column1: # THE VIEWS (`aontu view`, docs/design/VIEWS.0.md and VIEWS-ORDER.0.md):
# the figures of one document's link graph, generated value, provenance
# record and subsumption order, drawn as text or, for the cell-based
# kinds, as SVG under the integer rule (every coordinate a whole
# number of a fixed cell, so no font is measured).
# Four columns: name, view, src, expect. The options ride `expect.ask`,
# the WHOLE ViewOptions object (`kind` included) for the reason reaches'
# endpoints do: the same document draws differently under a relation
# filter, from a named root, in another order or profile. The rest of
# `expect` is the report: {kind, text, loss, verdict} on `rendered` and
# `lossy`, {kind, errors, loss: []} on `error`, each error minus its
# prose. A poset's further documents ride `ask.docs` as {src, name}.
# What the rows pin, kind by kind:
#   tree    -- a declared inverse pair collapses to ONE edge, drawn under
#              the named relation or the code-point-least key; a shared
#              subtree is expanded once and marked (*) after; a closing
#              edge is (cycle); a root is a node nothing depends on; a
#              named root draws its subtree alone; a root or relation
#              that names nothing is a refusal; a label is the shortest
#   matrix  -- canon and partition orders, the closure (+), the
#              unmirrored mark (!), a self-edge on the diagonal, the
#              stacked index header at ten rows, the cycle_block loss,
#              the one-relation rule and its refusals;
#   graph   -- mermaid, dot and er, inverse suppression, --group-by and
#              (n_ / nq_), both escape tables, the crossing count, the
#   layer   -- the bands in derived order, sideways and upward edges,
#   sets    -- the panel over generated values, a map or list universe,
#   layers  -- the provenance panel over one document, --at, --min-size;
#   ladder  -- the rungs in rank order, mermaid and dot, the refusals;
#   poset   -- covers over the closure, the quotient by mutual
#              subsumption, the dashed undecided edge, dot, the refusals;
#   and for every kind: --max-rows is a refusal, an unknown kind or
#   profile is a refusal, a hidden contribution is loss.
# Every expectation below was obtained from the canonical port and then
# held to the Go port by go/spec_test.go (AGENTS.md, "The parity probe").
